# Confirm recovering both draft types keeps each selection isolated

## What & Why
When an answer draft and an opportunity draft are both waiting for recovery, mouse recovery should reopen each one with its own selected values. A regression could accidentally apply one draft's category, status, or priority to the other.

## Done looks like
- Create an answer draft with a non-default category and an opportunity draft with non-default status and priority.
- Recover each draft with the mouse while both recovery notices exist.
- Assert each form restores its own text and selected values.

## Relevant files
- artifacts/escape-hatch/tests/persistence.spec.ts
